source: Owner's initial 16 axes, 12 proposed supporting axes, and owner follow-up progression tier axis + resource scope clarification

axes.label: Gear
axes.definition: Equipable/held equipment, intrinsic functionality, passive effects and equipment-provided abilities.
axes.boundary: Item presence is not proof of an independently usable spell or effect.

axes.label: Movement
axes.definition: Movement speed, flight, dashes, blink/teleport, mounting, water/air traversal and player travel between dimensions.
axes.boundary: Moving inventories belongs to logistics; creating dimensions belongs to world content.

axes.label: Ore processing
axes.definition: Crushing, refining, multiplying, washing or otherwise upgrading mined ore or raw metal inputs.
axes.boundary: Obtaining fresh ore is ore generation; general item crafting alone is crafting.

axes.label: Storage
axes.definition: Accessible items, fluids, magical reagents, inventories, portability, remote access and capacity.
axes.boundary: Stored FE/mana and its network belong to energy; transport between storage nodes belongs to logistics.

axes.label: Crafting
axes.definition: Recipes, rituals, infusion, potions, item synthesis, fabrication and conversion whose goal is producing crafted outputs.
axes.boundary: Enchanting/upgrading an existing object belongs to equipment augmentation; open-ended resource creation to general generation.

axes.label: Logistics
axes.definition: Transfer, routing, sorting, filtering and remote delivery of items, fluids, entities or resources.
axes.boundary: Player teleport belongs to movement; signal logic belongs to automation/control.

axes.label: Buffs
axes.definition: Temporary or maintained positive effects to players, allies and pets, including potion/spell auras.
axes.boundary: Persistent learned innate player-state changes belong to permanent power; healing is tracked separately.

axes.label: External compatibility
axes.definition: Native or pack-specific interactions that bridge distinct mods, APIs, energy types, entities or mechanics.
axes.boundary: A theme or theoretical KubeJS possibility does not count as an implemented bridge; also tag the actual functional axis.

axes.label: Mob farming
axes.definition: Renewable mob acquisition, capture, duplication, spawning, automated kills, drops and experience farming.
axes.boundary: A summoned ally is a companion; wild mob world-spawning additions are world content.

axes.label: Ore generation
axes.definition: Generation or acquisition of new ore/raw-ore equivalents through mining magic, miners, magical sources or repeated supply independent of an existing vanilla vein.
axes.boundary: Ordinary naturally placed ore veins belong to world content; ore doubling belongs to ore processing.

axes.label: Permanent power
axes.definition: Persistent player-state abilities, attunements, transformations, learned skills and irreversible character unlocks.
axes.boundary: Long-lived potions, wearable gear and renewable auras are buffs/gear, not innate permanent power.

axes.label: General generation
axes.definition: General-purpose creation, replication, exchange, transmutation or regeneration of useful resources from substitutes/currency/ambient systems.
axes.boundary: Ore-specific yields go to ore generation; fixed ordinary recipes go to crafting; processing existing ore goes to ore processing.

axes.label: Direct damage
axes.definition: Entity damage inflicted by spells, powers, traps, constructs or equipment-independent actions; record separately even if cast using gear.
axes.boundary: Damage reduction is defense; debuff-only effects belong to debuff/control.

axes.label: Block breaking
axes.definition: Active breaking, mining, excavation, timbering, harvesting or destruction of existing blocks, including spells and machines.
axes.boundary: Generating new ore/resources or changing biomes without breaking blocks is different.

axes.label: Permanent pets
axes.definition: Persistent owned, summoned, created or bound helpers/familiars/constructs that survive normal expiration and can continue service.
axes.boundary: Time-limited/single-use actors belong to temporary pets; mob farms are a distinct purpose.

axes.label: Temporary pets
axes.definition: Expiring or one-shot controlled minions, summons, temporary allies and short-lived constructs.
axes.boundary: A persistent tame or durable construct belongs to permanent pets; projectiles are direct damage.

axes.label: Defense
axes.definition: Wards, barriers, armor-independent mitigation, resistance, immunity, shielding and hazard protection.
axes.boundary: Healing after damage is healing/recovery; a shield as item is also tagged Gear.

axes.label: Healing & recovery
axes.definition: HP healing, hunger/saturation restoration, mana or ability-resource recovery and cleansing of harmful effects.
axes.boundary: Prevention of damage is defense; avoidance of death/death recovery is death/respawn.

axes.label: Debuffs & control
axes.definition: Slows, curses, crowd control, fear, roots, silence, disarming, forced motion, enemy disablement and targeting manipulation.
axes.boundary: Raw damage belongs to direct damage; positive status belongs to buffs.

axes.label: Energy
axes.definition: All distinct quantifiable power or spendable operating resources (not just FE), including EV, Anima, mana, Source, Media, lumen/starlight, soul-based charge and FE/OP when supported. Document generation, storage on blocks/players/items, use, transport, persistence, conversion and each resource's full progression.
axes.boundary: Energy is a typed pathway, not a generic FE API; never equate EV, player Anima, item charges and altar reservoirs without explicit proved conversion. Every storage scope must be separately investigated.

axes.label: Automation & control
axes.definition: Redstone, logic, sensing triggers, programmable computers, state evaluation and repeatable task sequencing.
axes.boundary: Transport alone is logistics, and the transformation being automated stays under its native axis.

axes.label: Agriculture & ecology
axes.definition: Crop/tree growth, fishing, animal breeding, food farming, biomass, gardening and natural-resource regeneration.
axes.boundary: Combat mob farms belong to mob farming; one-off cooked recipes to crafting.

axes.label: Detection & information
axes.definition: Locate/reveal ores, structures, mobs, threats, places, recipes, status, hidden world state and exploration guidance.
axes.boundary: Teleport is movement; uncovering new dimensions is world content.

axes.label: Equipment augmentation
axes.definition: Enchantment, reforging, socketing, upgrade tiers, imbuement and modification of existing items or tools.
axes.boundary: Initial creation belongs to crafting; innate learned skills to permanent power.

axes.label: World manipulation
axes.definition: Placement/building, terrain alteration, environmental changes, weather/time/light, protections and world-rule interactions.
axes.boundary: Simply adding generated biomes/structures is world content; breaking existing blocks is block breaking.

axes.label: World content
axes.definition: Added dimensions, biomes, structures, ambient ores, worldgen, encounter spawns and discoverable features.
axes.boundary: This is a content-impact axis, not necessarily a controllable player ability; do not mislabel it as ore generation.

axes.label: Death & respawn
axes.definition: Resurrection, death avoidance, corpse/grave/inventory preservation, respawn location and recovery after death.
axes.boundary: Routine HP healing belongs to healing/recovery; standard damage resistance is defense.

axes.label: Trade & economy
axes.definition: Merchant trades, bounty systems, currency, shops, barter, exchange markets and economic access paths.
axes.boundary: General programmable transmutation belongs to general generation; recipe synthesis to crafting.

axes.label: Progression tiers & unlocks
axes.definition: Actual formal mod progression tiers, research stages, altar/multiblock upgrades, personal unlock trees, dimension gates and meaningful nonformal access stages. Capture every transition and resulting new capabilities, from first usable to terminal branches.
axes.boundary: This is the mod's unlock graph, not a comparative ranking. Formal tiers must be source-backed; use analyst_stage only when the mod has no native tier name. Record player/item/block/world state and mandatory versus optional choices.
